purpose: Executable IGNITE unified-mask contract with remap/site provenance and immutable collapsed zero.

constraints.mask_statement: Require preprocessing revision, original label-map digest, source site, and specimen type before interpreting unified IDs or applying thresholds.
generation_handoff: Use a site- and specimen-matched H&E reference.
known_limitations: Certified enumeration and digest matching remain pending.

constraints.mask_statement: Preserve all collapsed unannotated/background zero pixels exactly; zero cannot seed, receive, bridge, or be crossed by any tissue edit.
generation_handoff: Do not inpaint protected zero pixels.
known_limitations: Collapsed zero cannot distinguish unannotated tissue from true background.

constraints.mask_statement: Change only declared source unified IDs to the selected target ID; preserve every other unified tissue label exactly and do not infer a native class from the coarse ID.
generation_handoff: Use retained native labels or H&E to render alveolar, bronchial, inflammatory, muscle, cartilage, fluid, liver, or keratin context correctly.
known_limitations: A lossy remap cannot deterministically recover native morphology.

constraints.mask_statement: Reject source splits, target merges, islands, new/filled holes, and global closing intended to repair the coarse mask.
known_limitations: Coarse holes may correspond to multiple different lung structures.
